design_note: Each instance combines the reused gate seed 13579 with nine new seeds; summaries are descriptive rather than ten independent post-selection replications.
decision_basis: The 36-run gate experiment was complete and fully validated. GA-G-Hybrid improved over Greedy by 48.70%, 28.38%, and 46.37% for k=1 on the 3-, 4-, and 5-layer PPI networks, respectively. VNS-G-FI was not competitive for these configurations.
